data.text: For final-interface-feedback owner: facility service emits facility.updated notifications and persists incidents in facility_incidents(id,body JSON). GET /api/facility returns rule_id/board_id/title/summary/severity/status/simulation/actions/action_results/opened_at/recovered_at. Incidents latch once until actual recovery; acknowledgements not recoveries. Current sound action_results {status:'available',output:'browser',requires_opt_in:true}; optional chime is browser-only and explicitly muted initially. No physical speaker queue added here; please consume active/recovered transitions via one feedback adapter if integrating verified speaker/TTS/WhatsApp. Match event.id to incident id+phase for dedup, preserve sim labels, don't replay tones on reconnect.
